title: members see a display name; the legal name stays with the platform

criteria.text: Signup requires a legal name; no account without it
criteria.note: [V] the profile screen requires 2-120 characters (signup/profile.ts, OnboardingFlow, handler signup-profile-set; #497, review-skipped), and since #1032 (2026-10-24, closes #847, review-skipped) src/proxy.ts sends any signed-in GET outside /onboarding, /auth and /api to /onboarding when members.legal_name is null or blank, whatever PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED says; builders exempt; an httpOnly su_named cookie skips the lookup once a name is found; onboarding/page.tsx no longer bounces a named-less member to /. So the email-then-code sign-in (#946) now lands on the profile step before any other page. members.legal_name stays nullable (migration 20261007200000): the gate, not the schema, is what refuses. Shipped: deploy-health on 730abcf itself was cancelled, superseded six seconds later by e97cdf0 (green), which contains it. Smoked: unknown, /onboarding has no live address in evals/smoke/live.spec.ts and the smoke signs in as builders, who are exempt. Checked: no, src/proxy.test.ts carries [guards F077.1 partial: the redirect; not the signup form]; the form tests are unmarked (profile.test.ts, onboarding/actions.test.ts, OnboardingFlow.test.tsx, signup-profile-set.test.ts); the whole-criterion marker is #610's

criteria.text: Display name shown wherever a peer would see the legal name
criteria.note: [V] the display name is collected at signup (OnboardingFlow, #497 review-skipped) and is what every peer-facing surface shows: a Page's 'Started by' line reads page_founder_public, which returns display_name only (migration 20260930180000, #249, no Reviewed by, deploy-health green on aba449d), and the following list shows display_name (get-member-follows.ts). Posts are by Pages, responses do not exist, the member profile is retired (#303), so those are every surface the criterion names that exists. Checked: yes, tests/f077-display-name-db.test.ts marked [guards F077.2] (#1072, 2026-10-26, closes #1013 today; deploy-health green on a9d265d): against a real database the Started by read returns the display name and no legal-name column to the founder and a peer and nothing to a stranger, the following list reads no legal name, and legal_name is read only by the signup gate, profile form and operator note; seen failing against a Page function that also returns legal_name. Smoked: page opened green 2026-10-25 to 10-27, you-following 10-19 (cd913c7); the smoke looks for stray emails, not names
